display.purpose: The value on a note. 48px on the drenched note, 32px below 560px.

headline.purpose: The module name in the page header.

title.purpose: Panel headings; 14px inside a panel or note, 20px for statement heads.

figure.purpose: Secondary totals inside panels and statement balances, 17 to 24px.

label.purpose: Field labels, card and KPI labels, pills. Sentence case.

rail-label.purpose: Uppercase group headings in the left rail only.

wordmark.purpose: The name IMPRESA beside the brand seal.

mono.purpose: Serials, dates, the exchange rate, the supporting-currency line, chart ticks.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Contact: panels, cards, notes, the active rail item and active tab.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Float: dropdown lists, the drenched note, account card hover, the login card, the open mobile rail.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: The dialog sheet over a 42% ink scrim.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Fields and compound fields on focus, with a Córdoba Ink border.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for entrances, bar growth, the line draw and the note flip.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and focus transitions on controls; 120ms on table rows; 100ms press (1px down).

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: A module body or modal entering: 5px up from 35% opacity.

motion.name: flip-in
motion.purpose: Numerals swapping in place when the leading currency is flipped; the note changes ink over 500ms.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: A value counting to its new figure when it changes within the same currency.

motion.name: grow
motion.purpose: Bars and composition segments growing from the left.

motion.name: saved
motion.purpose: A just-saved row flashing, then resting on Córdoba Wash until hovered.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions collapse to an instant change; count-ups jump to the final value.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Notes and dashboard spans become one column.

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: The rail goes off-canvas behind a menu button; header stops being sticky; gutter 16px.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Forms become one column; note value 32px; serial hidden; tabs scroll sideways.

narrative.overview:
IMPRESA keeps the money of a Nicaraguan print and embroidery shop, and it draws that money the way the shop holds it: as banknotes. A total is a note with an engraved frame, a rosette seal, a serial and a guilloché band along its foot, printed in the ink of its currency. Córdobas are deep blue, dollars are green, and both values are always on the note; the reader only chooses which one is read first.

Everything around the notes is quiet stationery. A pale green-grey paper ground, a slightly darker rail, off-white sheets with hairline borders, and white fields to write in. The interface is dense and calm because it is used all day at a desktop to register sales and expenses in seconds; ornament is spent only on totals and on the brand seal. Gold foil is the one warm colour, and it means "live or still open": the working month, the current module, an open period, money still owed.

The system refuses the row of four equal metric tiles it replaced. A number that matters is a note with its breakdown beside it, so the figure can be explained from the accounts and movements it comes from.
keyCharacteristics: Totals are banknotes: framed, sealed, serialled, with a guilloché band, in the ink of the leading currency.
Two inks: córdoba blue and dollar green. Every amount shows both currencies, one in front and one in support.
Foil gold is reserved for what is active or pending.
Archivo on its width axis: the more a number matters, the wider it is set. Red Hat Mono for codes, dates and rates.
Tonal paper layering with hairlines; shadows only for things that float.
All imagery is line work drawn in code (SVG, `currentColor`); there are no raster assets.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: An amount in córdobas is blue and an amount in dollars is green. A cash-total note takes the ink of whichever currency leads. Blue also carries the interface's actions; green never does.

rules.name: The Foil Rule
rules.body: Gold marks what is live or still owed attention: the working month, the current module, an open period, a pending or receivable amount, a warning. A settled figure is never gold. Solid foil is a dot, not a text colour; gold text is always Foil Text on Foil Wash.

rules.name: The In And Out Rule
rules.body: Green In and red Out are reserved for the direction of money and for delete. They are never used to decorate a neutral figure.

rules.name: The Wide Numeral Rule
rules.body: Width follows importance: 100% for body, 106 to 108% for figures and the page heading, 112% for a note value, 120% for the wordmark. Nothing is widened for emphasis alone.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with tabular numerals, in tables, notes, fields and bold figures alike, so columns and counting numerals do not shift.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Codes Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Mono carries serials, dates, rates and the supporting-currency line. It is never used for labels, headings or prose.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces by tone and hairline first. The Float shadow is for an element that sits above the page or is the single drenched note; it is never the resting state of an ordinary panel.

rules.name: The Engraving Rule
rules.body: Guilloché bands and rosettes belong to total notes and to the brand mark (rail, login card, sale sheet header). They sit behind or beside content at 22 to 34% opacity and never carry data. They are not a background for ordinary panels, tables or empty states.

dos: Do present a module's main total as a Note with its breakdown beside it, and keep the drenched note to a single one per screen.
Do show every amount in both currencies: the leading one large in its ink, the other below it smaller or in mono.
Do print córdoba amounts in Córdoba Ink and dollar amounts in Dollar Ink wherever a balance is tied to one currency.
Do keep gold for the working month, the current module, open periods, pending amounts and warnings, as Foil Text on Foil Wash.
Do set figures wider as they matter more (106 to 112%) and always with tabular numerals.
Do outline delete actions in red with no fill and set them 14px apart from the safe actions beside them.
Do draw new icons and ornament as SVG strokes in `currentColor` (24px grid, 1.7px round stroke for icons).
Do honour reduced motion: count-ups, bar growth, the line draw and the note flip all collapse to an instant change.
donts: Don't lay out totals as a row of equal metric tiles; that is the dashboard this system replaced.
Don't use guilloché bands or rosettes on ordinary panels, tables or empty states; they belong to notes and the brand mark.
Don't use gold on a settled figure, or solid Foil Gold as a text colour (it is 3.9:1 on a sheet).
Don't use Dollar Ink for buttons, links or focus; actions are Córdoba Ink.
Don't give a resting panel the Float shadow, or round a note past 6px so that it reads as a card.
Don't set labels, headings or prose in Red Hat Mono.
Don't use text lighter than Ink Tertiary on any paper tone.
